name: Pork Tenderloin Medallions with Creamy Dijon Sauce

fit.note: 470 cal and 7g carbs sit dead-center of the band; tenderloin scales by weigh-and-divide, cream pan-sauce scales linearly. Budget meal-prep dinner, no starch base.

dupe.evidence: creamy-garlic-herb-wine-pork-chops (accepted this run) is also a creamy white-wine pan-sauce seared-pork skillet with no starch; matches 3 of 4 axes (pork / skillet wine-cream reduction / low-carb no-starch). Distinguished here by cut (tenderloin medallions vs chops) and signature flavor (Dijon mustard cream vs garlic-herb cream) - a real plate-level distinction akin to steak Diane vs au poivre, so ruled KEEP not DUPE.
